entries.title: Dynamic Load on a Beam Bridge
entries.description: A 3D beam bridge made of connected rectangular segments spans a gap while moving colored box “vehicles” cross it, causing the bridge segments to flex, change color from green to red with stress, and display live force vectors and numeric labels above each support.

entries.title: Suspension Bridge in High Winds
entries.description: A suspension bridge with cables made from chains of small spheres sways as invisible wind forces push on a translucent deck, with cable tension visualized as changing thickness and color, and a side meter showing wind speed and deck deflection over time.

entries.title: Arch Bridge Compression Visualization
entries.description: A stone arch bridge made from wedge-shaped blocks experiences increasing vertical loads from stacked cylinders, with contact forces shown as short arrows between blocks, blocks slightly shifting if compression is too high, and stressed joints glowing red.

entries.title: Truss Bridge Under Moving Train
